result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but one visible text truncation issue was found that appears unintentional.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' appears to be cut off — it renders as 'Tokumaru Ramei' in the card, suggesting either a rendering/font issue or a text truncation bug replacing the last character(s) incorrectly.
issues.suggestion: Verify the text rendering pipeline for restaurant names in the 'Popular right now' section. Ensure the font renders the letter 'n' correctly and that no character substitution or truncation is occurring mid-word.
